> Template cho Phase Design — định nghĩa giao diện đẹp trước khi code.

## 1. Design System

### Palette
| Token | Hex | Usage |
|-------|-----|-------|
| `--color-primary` | `#6366f1` | CTA, link, active |
| `--color-secondary` | `#0ea5e9` | Complement, info |
| `--color-accent` | `#f59e0b` | Highlight, badge |
| `--color-neutral-900` | `#0f172a` | Text primary |
| `--color-neutral-100` | `#f8fafc` | Background |
| `--color-surface` | `#ffffff` | Card, surface |

### Typography
- **Sans:** `Inter` / system-ui — body, UI
- **Display:** `Plus Jakarta Sans` — heading
- Scale: `xs 12 / sm 14 / base 16 / lg 18 / xl 20 / 2xl 24`

### Spacing / Radius / Shadow
```css
:root {
  --space-1: 4px; --space-2: 8px; --space-4: 16px; --space-6: 24px; --space-8: 32px;
  --radius-sm: 8px; --radius-md: 12px; --radius-lg: 16px; --radius-full: 9999px;
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
  --shadow-lg: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
}
```

## 2. Wireframe

### Mobile 375px
```
[Header: logo | menu]
[Hero: title + CTA]
[Content: single column, card stack]
[Footer]
```

### Tablet 768px
```
[Header: logo | nav | CTA]
[Hero: 2-col]
[Content: 2-col grid]
```

### Desktop 1280px
```
[Header: logo | nav | actions]
[Hero: 2-col with visual]
[Content: 3-col grid, max-width 1280 centered]
```

## 3. Component Inventory

| Component | States | Notes |
|-----------|--------|-------|
| Button primary | default/hover/focus/active/disabled/loading | hover: translateY(-1px) + shadow |
| Card | default/hover | hover: shadow-md → shadow-lg |
| Input | default/focus/error/disabled | focus: outline 2px primary |
| Empty state | illustration + message + CTA |  |
| Loading | skeleton / spinner |  |
| Error | message + Retry button |  |

## 4. UX States

| View | Loading | Empty | Error | Success |
|------|---------|-------|-------|---------|
| List | skeleton 3 rows | "Chưa có dữ liệu" + CTA | "Lỗi tải" + Retry | toast 3s |
| Form | disable submit + spinner | — | inline error | toast + redirect |

## 5. Animation
- Transition: `150-300ms ease` (transform, opacity)
- Hover: `transform: translateY(-1px)` + shadow
- Toast: slide-in 200ms, auto-dismiss 3s

## 6. Accessibility
- Contrast ≥ 4.5:1
- Focus ring: `outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px`
- Icon-only button: `aria-label`
- Keyboard: Tab order, Enter/Space
